errors.database_url_required: OCTOPUS_DATABASE_URL is required (postgres:// DSN); see docs/deploy.md
errors.gateway_mode_invalid: OCTOPUS_LLM_GATEWAY={mode:%q}: want on, off or auto
errors.disk_free_unsupported: disk free check not supported on this platform
errors.docker_saas_refused: OCTOPUS_SAAS_MODE=1 with the Docker agent runtime: agents of different tenants would share one kernel and one network. Set OCTOPUS_AGENT_RUNTIME=kubernetes, or OCTOPUS_ALLOW_DOCKER_SAAS=1 for a box with no real tenants
errors.kubernetes_needs_license: OCTOPUS_AGENT_RUNTIME=kubernetes needs an Enterprise license with kubernetes; set OCTOPUS_LICENSE_KEY, or unset OCTOPUS_AGENT_RUNTIME to run agents in Docker
errors.kubernetes_not_in_build: OCTOPUS_AGENT_RUNTIME=kubernetes, but this build has no Kubernetes runtime (built without ee/); unset OCTOPUS_AGENT_RUNTIME to run agents in Docker

log.data_dir_not_a_volume: {path} is in this container but is not a named Docker volume, so agents cannot mount it and their runs will fail. Use a named volume or set OCTOPUS_DATA_VOLUME.
log.dev_mode_every_interface: every interface in this container — exposure is whatever the published port allows
log.dev_mode_warning: WARNING: OCTOPUS_DEV_MODE=1 — no accounts; the browser holding the dev-session token is the owner; listening on {addr} ({confinement})
log.dev_mode_open: dev mode: open the dashboard with {url} (or run `thulu open`)
log.docker_client_unavailable: Docker client unavailable ({err}); kubernetes mode — continuing without Docker
log.docker_unreachable: Docker not reachable ({err}); kubernetes mode — continuing without Docker
log.docker_saas_allowed: WARNING: SaaS mode on the Docker agent runtime (OCTOPUS_ALLOW_DOCKER_SAAS=1); agents of different tenants share the host kernel and network
log.browser_shared_saas: WARNING: SaaS mode with a shared thulu-browser (OCTOPUS_BROWSER_MODE=shared); every workspace's browser scripts run in one process, next to the run keys of the others
log.legacy_stage_cmds_migrated: migrated stage cmds for {count} project(s) into hooks
log.refresh_token_gc_purged: refresh token GC: purged {count} expired tokens
log.audit_retention_gc_purged: audit retention GC: purged {count} entries older than {days} days
log.agent_content_vacuumed: agent content vacuum: pruned {pruned} revision(s), freed {freed} blob(s)
log.sandbox_memory_invalid: OCTOPUS_SANDBOX_MEMORY_BYTES={value:%q} is not a valid size; using default
log.version_recorded: version {version:%q} recorded in the audit log
log.version_changed: version changed to {version:%q} (from/to recorded in the audit log)
log.kube_janitor_sweep_done: sweep done in {elapsed}: agent_pods={agents} sandbox_pods={sandboxes} worktree_claims={claims}

log.disk_pressure_persists: WARNING: still below the {floor}% floor after sweeping; the space is held by something the janitor does not manage

log.bad_questions_grace: {env} is not a duration such as 30m or 2h; using {default}

log.workspace_backfill_stamped: workspace backfill: stamped {count} unstamped {table} row(s) with workspace {workspace}

comments.worktree_parked: This task's worktree was idle for a long time, so Thulu freed its disk. Pending changes were committed to the task branch; the next run checks it out again.
comments.sandbox_relaunch_failed: The task got a sandbox slot but its stage could not be relaunched: {err}. It left the sandbox line; relaunch it when that is fixed.
